notes: Digital PDF, 72 pages. idx0 cover (Cherrybrook Technology High School, 2023, Year 12, AP4, Mathematics Advanced; file name 'AP4 CTHS Trial Exam'), idx1 blank, idx2-5 Section I (Q1-10), idx6-32 Section II (Q11-35), idx33-34 extra writing space, idx35 answer sheet; idx36-71 are a second copy of the whole paper with the school's HANDWRITTEN worked solutions (blue ink, some red/orange teacher marks) drawn over it: solutions transcribed from those images (idx38-70); MCQ key from the circled options. No marking guideline or mark allocation is given, so marks_breakdown is null. Section I 10 marks, Section II 90 marks (Q11-24 = 43, printed on idx17; Q25-35 = 47). Numbering correct. Paper wording kept as printed: Q18(b) 'Is the approximate for'; Q19 'T is the midpoint' (T not italic); Q24 piecewise function printed with a closing brace; Q20(b) asks for 2 dp but the school's solution gives r=-0.955. School solution errors/oddities kept as written: Q11 third alternative has int_c^a (printed as written); Q23(c) gives 'approx 20 days' (exact 19.6); Q35(c) second derivative written '=9.456>0' (the true value is negative, which is what confirms a maximum) and '-6cos2' was read as cos alpha; Q34(b) result '47560.00131' as read from the handwriting; Q32 solution refers to equation (1) (p+q=4) that the school never wrote down; Q10 teacher added 'pi/2<x<pi' beside the question (kept in the solution only); Q5 has an orange mark in the margin, ignored.
